annotations.title: Find a business already on Google

description: Search GOOGLE MAPS for listings that match a business, to check whether it already exists before creating a new Business Profile listing (a duplicate gets suspended). Pass exactly one of query (free text, e.g. "Blue Bottle Coffee Oakland") or location (a partial listing with at least title, plus storefrontAddress for a precise match). At most 10 matches, no paging. A match with claimed:true is already managed by someone: send the owner to its requestAdminRightsUri instead of creating a duplicate. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs Google Business Profile connected.

location.description: a partial listing: {title, storefrontAddress:{regionCode, addressLines, locality, postalCode}}

query.description: free text: the business name and city

name: search_google_listings
